# Sonnatt.ai

> Sonnatt.ai gives Leeds and Bradford businesses one dedicated account manager who builds and runs their website, chatbot, custom apps and marketing. A real team does the work and uses AI to move quickly. Based in Leeds, West Yorkshire.

## Key facts
- Chatbot plan: £99 setup then £49 a month. A website chatbot set up for the business, added to any existing website with one line of code; enquiries are emailed to the business. Can be started online.
- Starter plan: £299 setup then £149 a month. A 5-page website built from an industry design, with the chatbot built in, hosting, Google Business Profile setup and up to an hour of changes a month. Can be started online.
- Setup: £995 one-off (discovery and strategy session, website and chatbot built and live, connected to existing systems, team training).
- Ongoing: £995 a month for single-site businesses, cancel any time (hosting and running costs, marketing and social media management, monthly review call, priority support).
- Sonnatt Scale: from £3,000 a month, scoped after discovery, for multiple sites, locations and system integrations.
- Services: website build and hosting, chatbot and systems, marketing and social growth, custom apps, workflow automation, ongoing support.
- Who it is for: letting and property management, accountants and advisers, clinics and practices, salons, gyms and venues, trades and contractors.
- Area: based in Leeds, West Yorkshire, UK; works with businesses in Leeds, Bradford and across Yorkshire (most work can be done remotely).
- No long contract: cancel any time with 30 days' notice.
- Contact: info@sonnattai.com, or the form at https://sonnattai.com/#contact (free 15-minute walkthrough).
- The presenter "Emma" in the site's introduction video is AI-generated, and the website chat assistant is automated (scripted answers; booking requests go to the team by email).

- [Free website check](https://sonnattai.com/check/): free tool that scores a business website out of 100 on security, speed, mobile, Google and enquiry capture, with plain-English fixes.
## Guides
- [How much does a small business website cost in Leeds?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/small-business-website-cost-leeds/): A small business website has two costs: the one-off build and the ongoing cost of keeping it running, which covers hosting, security updates, changes and the marketing that brings people to it.
- [Does my small business need a website chatbot?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/does-my-business-need-a-website-chatbot/): A website chatbot is worth having if people regularly ask you the same questions, contact you outside working hours, or leave your site without getting in touch.
- [How to set up and optimise your Google Business Profile](https://sonnattai.com/guides/google-business-profile-guide/): Your Google Business Profile is the box that appears on Google Search and Maps when people look for your business or for what you do nearby.
- [Website vs social media: which does a small business need?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/website-vs-social-media-small-business/): Most small businesses need both, because they do different jobs.
- [How to get more Google reviews (without breaking Google's rules)](https://sonnattai.com/guides/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): The way to get more Google reviews is to ask every happy customer, at the right moment, with a direct link that makes it take seconds.
- [What to put on your website so customers get in touch](https://sonnattai.com/guides/what-to-put-on-a-small-business-website/): A small business website should answer the questions customers have before they contact you, and make contacting you easy.
- [What should an accountant's website include?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/what-should-an-accountants-website-include/): An accountant's website should make it obvious which clients you work with and what you do for them, give an idea of fees, and show why people can trust you: qualifications, professional body membership, real reviews and the people behind the firm.
